content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing issues with the Download/Upload feature found in the menu of [product_name] Web Editor. I appreciate any assistance in advance.
Please attach a screenshot of "Control Panel\Network and Internet\Network Connections".
I use [product_name] software for uploading and downloading, which works correctly. My PC's IP is 192.168.1.54 and the [product_name] device is at 192.168.1.10.
Did you attempt to launch [product_name] Web Editor with administrator privileges? Best wishes, [user_name]
Please share the article number of your [product_name].
[user_name] asked for the [company_name] article number. It usually starts with [article_no], for example: [article_no] or [article_no]. You can find it on the front of the device.

The Web Editor is not compatible with these [product_name] devices. Pages created using the Web Editor can only be loaded onto the latest series, specifically [product_name] version [version_no]. These are identified by new article numbers structured like [article_no] (where the middle section varies). This is why [user_name] requested your device's article number.
Check this website for information on delivery release for [product_name] version [version_no].

Unrelated to the main discussion, but consider using 'part number' instead of 'order number' for clarity, as some regions interpret 'order number' as a purchasing reference. Also, in English, 'request' is preferred over 'demand.' Apologies for any confusion caused.
Thank you for the helpful information.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced problems using the Download/Upload feature in [product_name] Web Editor with certain [product_name] devices. The conversation clarifies that the Web Editor is compatible only with the newest [product_name] version [version_no] series, not older modules. This highlights a gap in understanding software and hardware compatibility, causing user confusion.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to use the [product_name] Web Editor’s download and upload capabilities with their [product_name] modules without encountering compatibility limitations or requirements.
